_comment: Copy to sanitize-identity.json (gitignored) and fill in your own values. Used by scripts/sanitize-for-public.js to scrub personal data before publishing the mirror.
_usernames: OS username(s) that appear in absolute paths, e.g. C:/Users/<name>/
_names: Real name and its parts. Matched on word boundaries; longest first.
_school: School or employer names you would rather not publish.
_courses: Course codes or internal project codes tied to your identity.
_projects: Private or client project directory names.
_protected: Strings that must SURVIVE scrubbing even though they contain a name above — typically this repo's own public URL.
_allowExamples: Repo-relative paths to docs whose credential-SHAPED strings are teaching examples (secret-pattern tables, truncated PEM stubs). Suppresses secret:* findings for those files ONLY; identity findings still fail the check.
